name: libairbender
description: Airbender I/O, delegations and accelerators (libairbender) for bflat guests

objects.note: In front of the linker script, where bflat linked --extlib static libraries before schema 2.

wrap.note: libairbender's __wrap_memcpy: long copies through the u256 delegation, word loops otherwise.

options.note: The u256 delegation emitted in place of the call to libairbender's airbender_u256_op: the operands are in x10-x12 by the calling convention and the circuit writes its flag back to x12. A JIT without the knob keeps the call, which libairbender answers with the same delegation.
